stemMarkdown: How many people read at least one of the two newspapers?
solutionMarkdown:
Work in percentages first, then convert once:

$60 + 45 - 20 = 85\%$

$400 \times 0.85 = 340$

**340 people**. Adding 60% and 45% to 105% and not subtracting the overlap gives an impossible figure above the survey size — a built-in warning that the overlap was missed.
